claims.statement: First independent public commission: an altarpiece for the chapel of San Bernardo. It was never delivered and was reassigned in 1481.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Florentine government records.
